body.statement: For the corrected finite all-cells translation of an ordinary full kernel \(Q[S_0]\), the complete unconditional CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) recursion on the translated family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\) accepts exactly when the ordinary single-world ID recursion accepts \(Q[S_0]\) from \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\).  This is an equivalence of the two finite operational recursions; it is not a new semantic completeness theorem under event-local positivity.
body.proof_tex:
Every member of \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\) is a single-world interventional kernel \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  Under the all-cells translation, a labelled counterfactual term has one world label \(b\), so two copies never require a cross-world consistency or equality-type decision.  Counterfactual ancestor expansion therefore returns the ordinary ancestors in the mutilated graph, and the ancestral-set transformation retains exactly the same vertices and intervention labels as ordinary ID.

We prove equality of the recursion traces by induction on the size of the current source vertex set \(U\).  For the base case \(U=C\), both recursions return the same marginal of the same kernel.  For the induction step, the published IDENTIFY\({}^{+}\) recursion forms the least set \(H\), \(C\subseteq H\subseteq U\), closed against a parent-subscript value carried by a term outside \(H\).  With one world label, this is exactly the ordinary ancestor restriction for the intervention assignment \(b\).  If \(H=C\), both recursions return the corresponding marginal.  If \(H=U\ne C\), both return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\).  Otherwise both retain the unique bidirected district of \(G[H]\) containing \(C\).  The published recursion lemma states that the new source set is strictly smaller, so the induction hypothesis applies.  Thus every factor call has the same success or failure status.  The outer algorithms use the same ancestral districts and require every all-cells assignment branch to succeed, so their final acceptance decisions coincide.

No division by a source-cell probability occurs in this trace comparison: the inputs are symbolic full kernels.  When a later physical certificate chooses a conditioned slice, positivity is checked only for that used conditioning event before the recursion is invoked.
